decisions.reason: The feature's launch announcement and low marginal cost keep the option open while its market value remains uncertain.
The wallet has high strategic value but also competition and regulatory costs, so it is kept open with moderate drop risk.
As a niche login authenticator with unclear traction, the option is inexpensive to keep but faces a higher chance of abandonment.
A dedicated page signals commitment and the framework's reusable code lowers keeping costs, so it is retained.
The multi-service app platform offers broader optionality and synergies with existing identity products, so it remains open.
The security library has low ongoing cost and potential integration value, so it is kept with limited drop risk.
